answer: Weighted trust beats volume. One real worker who has shipped audited code, paid a fee and earned peer endorsements casts one signal, while a cluster of fresh wallets vouching for each other casts a pattern that only looks like growth. So the economy prices admission: bond a small deposit, publish work the panel can read, and let decay erode what you have not maintained. A garden of such identities needs tending, and the sybil farm is a spiral that rewards churn. Requiring each seat to spend before it speaks, and to keep speaking after it spends, is what separates the two.
